<thought>Based on the observed monoisotopic m/z = 268.193948 (likely [M+H]⁺), the neutral mass is ≈267.1867 Da. Matching this mass to integer combinations of C, H, O, and N, the formula C₁₉H₂₅N fits within ~45 ppm and yields an integer double‑bond equivalent, making it the most plausible molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C19H25N</final_answer>
